comment: Mandatory checks (S2) per CI-FAST. A PR is ok only if every listed check ran on the PR head SHA and succeeded. Changing this list needs a reason in the PR.
comment_path_filtered: Checks that run on a pull request only when it changes the files in the workflow's paths filter; required only when they ran on the PR head SHA.
comment_path_filters: Copied verbatim from each path-filtered workflow's on.pull_request paths/paths-ignore; ci-ok uses them to decide whether the workflow had to run, and 'ci_ok.py --self-check' reports it when they differ from the workflow file.
